_comment: Chimora shop offers. The only source for offers (docs/MONETIZATION.md). Prices: rg_price in Riftglass (0 = not for Riftglass), eur_cents = direct store price tier; the shop always shows the price text the store sends. Server copy: tools/shop/build_offers_sql.py.

offers.name: Ring Tonic
offers.desc: A Spirling gains 1 Ring at once. Never above the Ring cap.

offers.name: Great Ring Tonic
offers.desc: A Spirling gains 5 Rings at once. Never above the Ring cap.

offers.name: Ring Elixir
offers.desc: A Spirling rises to the current Ring cap.

offers.name: Growth Crystal
offers.desc: Double growth for the whole team for the next 20 battles.

offers.name: Great Growth Crystal
offers.desc: Triple growth for the whole team for the next 20 battles.

offers.name: Team Growth Band
offers.desc: Growth is shared evenly by all team members, also those who did not fight. Permanent.

offers.name: Ring Tonic x5
offers.desc: 5 Ring Tonics. Each gives 1 Ring.

offers.name: Riftheart
offers.desc: Held memento: +15% Might. Permanent, 1 piece.

offers.name: Glass Shield

offers.name: Core Glass
offers.desc: Held memento: +12% Vigor. Permanent, 1 piece.

offers.name: Ember Prism
offers.desc: Held memento: +20% damage for Ember techniques. Permanent.

offers.name: Tide Prism
offers.desc: Held memento: +20% damage for Tide techniques. Permanent.

offers.name: Hold Stone
offers.desc: Held memento: once per battle survives a hit from full Vigor with 1 Vigor.

offers.name: Echo Ring
offers.desc: Held memento: heals 1/10 of Vigor every round.

offers.name: Rift Script: Glowglass Slash
offers.desc: Teaches Glowglass Slash (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, 20% chance to scorch) to one Ember Spirling. Used up.

offers.name: Rift Script: Floodglass Wave
offers.desc: Teaches Floodglass Wave (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, 20% chance to soak) to one Tide Spirling. Used up.

offers.name: Rift Script: Vineglass Sting
offers.desc: Teaches Vineglass Sting (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, heals 25% of the damage) to one Bloom Spirling. Used up.

offers.name: Rift Script: Boltglass Bite
offers.desc: Teaches Boltglass Bite (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, 30% chance to lower Pace) to one Volt Spirling. Used up.

offers.name: Rift Script: Rockglass Ram
offers.desc: Teaches Rockglass Ram (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, 30% chance to raise own Guard) to one Stone Spirling. Used up.

offers.name: Rift Script: Stormglass Cut
offers.desc: Teaches Stormglass Cut (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, strikes first) to one Gale Spirling. Used up.

offers.name: Rift Script: Lightglass Beam
offers.desc: Teaches Lightglass Beam (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, cures the user's own condition) to one Lumen Spirling. Used up.

offers.name: Rift Script: Duskglass Grip
offers.desc: Teaches Duskglass Grip (power 95, accuracy 100, 4 energy, 30% chance to lower Focus) to one Umbra Spirling. Used up.

offers.name: Technique Memory
offers.desc: Spirlings can relearn forgotten techniques at any time. Permanent for the account.

offers.name: Overcharge Core
offers.desc: The whole team starts the next battle with 12 instead of 10 energy, maximum 12.

offers.name: Overcharge Core x5
offers.desc: 5 Overcharge Cores.

offers.name: Rift Breath
offers.desc: In battle: revives a defeated Spirling with 50% Vigor. At most 1 per battle.

offers.name: Great Rift Breath
offers.desc: In battle: revives with 100% Vigor and full energy. At most 1 per battle.

offers.name: Will to Win
offers.desc: If the whole team is defeated, the last one returns once with 30% Vigor. Not against Rift Wardens.

offers.name: Glass Spark
offers.desc: In battle: fills a Spirling's energy and adds 1 energy per round for 3 rounds.

offers.name: Riftglass Tonic
offers.desc: In battle: heals 100% Vigor and all states. At most 2 per battle.

offers.name: Battle Supply
offers.desc: 5 Rift Breaths, 5 Overcharge Cores, 5 Glass Sparks. Single price 1500 Riftglass.

offers.name: Bond Seal
offers.desc: The next bonding succeeds for sure. Not with Rift Wardens or one-of-a-kind Spirlings.

offers.name: Echo Scent
offers.desc: Bonding gets clearly easier for one try.

offers.name: Echo Scent x10
offers.desc: 10 Echo Scents. Single price 1000 Riftglass.

offers.name: Sixth Team Place
offers.desc: Your team holds 6 Spirlings instead of 5 in battles against the world. Permanent.

offers.name: Storage Box +1
offers.desc: One more storage box with 30 places. At most 12 extra boxes.

offers.name: Wayfarer Pass
offers.desc: +50% growth, 30 Riftglass every day, +1 starting energy, 1 free Rift Breath per Warden battle, +1 bond try per battle. 4,99 EUR per month, renews automatically, cancel any time in the store.

offers.name: Starter Pack
offers.desc: 300 Riftglass, 5 Ring Tonics, 1 Growth Crystal, 3 Rift Breaths, 3 Echo Scents. Once per account.

offers.name: Wayfarer Pack
offers.desc: 1000 Riftglass, Riftheart, Glass Shield, 2 Great Ring Tonics, 1 Bond Seal. Once per account.

offers.name: Rift Pack 1
offers.desc: 2 Great Ring Tonics, 1 Element Prism of your choice, 5 Rift Breaths. Once, after Rift 1 is sealed.

offers.name: Rift Pack 2
offers.desc: 2 Great Ring Tonics, 1 Element Prism of your choice, 5 Rift Breaths. Once, after Rift 2 is sealed.

offers.name: Rift Pack 3

offers.name: Rift Pack 4

offers.name: Rift Pack 6
offers.desc: 2 Great Ring Tonics, 1 Element Prism of your choice, 5 Rift Breaths. Once, after Rift 6 is sealed.

offers.name: Welcome Back Pack
offers.desc: 5 Great Ring Tonics and 1 Great Growth Crystal. Once per account, after 30 days away.

offers.name: Spark Forge
offers.desc: Sets all Spark values of one Spirling to the top (12). Shows the new values first.

offers.name: Spark Shard
offers.desc: Raises one chosen value by 6 Sparks, up to 12.

offers.name: Temper Shift
offers.desc: Sets a Spirling's temperament to one you choose.

offers.name: Five Spark Shards
offers.desc: 5 Spark Shards. Single price 1000 Riftglass.

offers.name: Power Core
offers.desc: Doubles the lean of one Spirling's temperament: +10% instead of +5% on its stat. Permanent.

offers.name: Gleam Prism
offers.desc: Turns one Spirling you choose into its Gleam form: +10% on all values and a Riftglass shimmer. At most 2 per week.

offers.name: Battle Speed x4
offers.desc: Battle text and animations play four times as fast. Permanent.

offers.name: Auto Battle
offers.desc: Your team fights wild Spirlings by itself. Not against Rift Wardens, story battles or in leagues. Permanent.

offers.name: Coin Gleam
offers.desc: Double coins from battles for 20 battles.

offers.name: Signpost
offers.desc: Fast travel to every place you have visited, not only rest spots. Permanent.

offers.name: Encounter Call
offers.desc: Twice as many wild encounters for 30 steps.

offers.name: Battle Skip x10
offers.desc: 10 skips. A wild battle against a foe at least 10 Rings lower is won at once, with full growth.

offers.name: Rematch Key
offers.desc: A beaten Wayfarer can be challenged again on the same day.

offers.name: Warden Lore
offers.desc: Before a Rift Warden battle you see its team, techniques and gifts. Permanent. Only after one try without help.

offers.name: Rift Anchor
offers.desc: After losing to a Warden, the next try starts right before it with a fully healed team.

offers.name: Warden Weakener
offers.desc: The Warden starts with 15% less Vigor. At most 1 per Warden battle, not in Rift-Born.

offers.name: Warden Bundle
offers.desc: Warden Lore, 3 Warden Weakeners and 5 Rift Anchors in one pack.

offers.name: League Power Pack
offers.desc: 5 Overcharge Cores Plus. They only work in the Open League.

offers.name: Echo Amplifier
offers.desc: Your echo team fights with +10% values when a friend plays with shop bonuses. Permanent.

offers.name: Coin Purse
offers.desc: Exactly 5000 coins. At most 3 per week.

offers.name: Great Coin Purse
offers.desc: Exactly 20000 coins. At most 1 per week.

offers.name: Merchant Discount
offers.desc: 20% lower coin prices in all merchant shops. Permanent.
